---
title: "Sign in to your profile"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-01 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

Sign in to your profile so that the system records your name on every
check-in, haircut, note and booking you make.

## Applies to

Every manager, at the start of each shift and whenever they take over the
shop tablet or computer.

{{< include /_shared/picking-your-name.qmd >}}

## What is different for managers

A manager's profile shows one more button at the top of the screen:
**Admin**, next to **Check-in** and **Calendar**. Signing in to your profile
does not open Admin. Admin asks for your passkey or PIN each time. See
[MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd).
